summary: Carmody Road through-route kerb, bushy bank beside the lane, no parking convention.

best_section.where: south side of Carmody Road, bush on the bank beside the lane

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush and a powerline corridor; apartments 17-18 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: No pull-off or shoulder visible; the lane edge runs straight into trees and bank, so no room to pull fully clear.
drivers.traffic: Collector road linking suburbs, with a junction at the start; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this side; a traffic-area parking control ends here.

flags: Mean grade 2.9%, max 7% in one step
Powerline overhead along the bush edge
Traffic noise from a through road
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the verge, mostly shaded from the south and east.
